competitors.name: CybSafe
competitors.entry_point: Admin-only Risk Quantification Impact Settings screen
competitors.setup_friction: None described beyond admin access; defaults exist out of the box (Major impact category)
core_flow: Set Expected Monetary Loss (1-4) via slider or text box
Set Expected Level of Effort (1-4) via slider or text box
Set Expected Level of Disruption (1-4) via slider or text box
Click Apply to recalculate combined score (values multiply, 1x1x1 to 4x4x4) mapped to Minor/Moderate/Major/Extreme
competitors.error_prevention: Slider and text box paired for precise input; not observed to have confirmation step
competitors.trust_model: Historical trend-over-time charts are explicitly protected from retroactive recalculation artifacts, preventing admin tuning from appearing as real score volatility
competitors.rbac_notes: Not detailed in source material beyond 'admin' access
competitors.repeat_use_efficiency: Single Apply action; no bulk or multi-step wizard needed
competitors.risk_score_surface: Observed — impact category (Minor/Moderate/Major/Extreme) surfaced from weighted consequence factors, not third-party telemetry categories
competitors.source_notes: CybSafe Help Center article on risk quantification impact settings; no live product access

observed_patterns: Decoupling retroactive weight recompute from historical trend chart continuity (CybSafe)
Pairing a slider with a precise numeric text input for every weighted factor (CybSafe)
Applying contextual risk modifiers based on role, seniority, or access level rather than uniform weighting (SoSafe, CybSafe)
anti_patterns: Trigger-only EDR integrations (KnowBe4, Hoxhunt) marketed adjacent to 'risk score' language without actually feeding a persistent, weighted score
Opaque 'combining telemetry' marketing language with no admin-visible explanation of the resulting calculation (SoSafe, and previously flagged for Right-Hand Cybersecurity in technical research)
differentiation_opportunities: No registry competitor publishes a documented, admin-tunable weighting model for third-party security-signal categories feeding a human risk score

No competitor publicly addresses how a person with zero instrumented telemetry (no EDR coverage) is treated in their score, making Dune's 'No Endpoint Visibility' signal a defensible, differentiated design choice
design_implications: Decouple live weight recompute from historical trend chart integrity when designing the risk score breakdown and any trend visualization
Pair every weight slider with a numeric input, not slider-only, in the Configure Risk Score Weights page
Write plain-language copy explaining what a weight change actually does to a score, since no competitor has solved this transparency gap
Flag role/access-based risk modifiers as a named future-phase idea, not required for v1
confidence_notes: CybSafe: medium confidence from a dedicated admin help center article
SoSafe and Hoxhunt: low-medium and low confidence respectively, marketing pages only, no admin documentation found
KnowBe4: low confidence, press release only, intentionally not benchmarked on risk-scoring quality per registry guidance
No live product trials or screenshots were available; all findings are from public marketing and help-center pages
